content.short: IntentX is an intent-based decentralized perpetual futures exchange on Mantle powered by the SYMMIO protocol for deep liquidity and tight spreads.
content.description: IntentX is a decentralized derivatives exchange using an intent-based architecture built on the SYMMIO protocol, matching traders with professional market makers through cryptographically signed intents rather than traditional AMM or orderbook models. This design enables deep liquidity and tight spreads across a wide range of perpetual contract pairs on the Mantle Network. The intent-based approach provides a user experience closer to centralized exchanges while maintaining full on-chain settlement and self-custody of funds.
content.meta: IntentX is an intent-based decentralized derivatives exchange for perpetual futures on Mantle. Discover IntentX on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
